name: Index-Translate (2B / 9B / 35B-A3B preview)

lineage.how_derived: multilingual mid-training (167.77B tokens), specialist SFT and RL, expert merging by parameter interpolation, multi-teacher on-policy distillation (card)

purpose: Multilingual text translation across 150 languages that follows translation instructions (glossary, format, style, context, output length) and translates text inside images without external OCR (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: LICENSE in the bilibili/Index-Translate repo read: Apache License 2.0 text; HF cards state apache-2.0.

architecture.kind: hybrid linear-attention plus full-attention dense transformer (Qwen3.5 architecture, with vision encoder via mmproj)
architecture.attention: full attention every 4th layer, linear attention in the others; 16 heads, 4 KV heads (9B config)
architecture.recurrent: linear attention (type not named in the card read)
architecture.drafter: MTP head present in the config (mtp_num_hidden_layers 1)

variants.notes: Q8_0 9.79 GB; vision needs mmproj Q8_0 0.62 GB

pc-16gb.variant: 9B GGUF Q8_0 or 35B-A3B Q4 with RAM offload

engine_support.notes: Vendor publishes GGUF with mmproj files; Qwen3.5 base is a model Tona already targets (ornith, qwen3.5 records), so the 9B shares the backbone.

benchmarks.name: WMT24++ COMET-22 (en to 20 languages)
benchmarks.harness: card table: Hy-MT2-7B 0.8593, Hy-MT2-30B-A3B 0.8624, TranslateGemma-12B 0.8524, Qwen3.5-9B base 0.8073

strengths: Builder table puts the 9B ahead of Hy-MT2-7B and TranslateGemma-12B on COMET and judge scores and far ahead on instruction following
Glossary, JSON/CSV/markdown preservation, placeholders, style control
weaknesses: All numbers are the builder's own, on its own benchmarks (instTrans, IFMTBench, WMT26 Judge)
TranslateGemma-12B instruction-following score is very low (0.3068), which says more about the benchmark's instruction focus than raw quality
Builder's German-specific numbers not shown in the card text read
best_for: multilingual document translation on small hardware
soft.maturity: Bilibili; 2B/9B released 2026-09-28, 35B-A3B marked preview; GGUF 9B repo has 63k downloads per HF API.

tona_fit.reason: Apache-2.0, Qwen3.5 backbone that Tona's work already touches, 5.8 GB at Q4 for the 9B, 150 languages and the strongest published instruction-following numbers among open translators; needs independent German evaluation before offering.

open_questions: Exact linear-attention type in the Qwen3.5 backbone
